verses.text: Don’t give glory to us, LORD, don’t give it to us. Give it to your name, because of your faithful love and your truth.
Why should the nations get to say, “So where’s their God now?”
Our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he wants.
Their idols are silver and gold, made by human hands.
They’ve got mouths but can’t talk. They’ve got eyes but can’t see.
They’ve got ears but can’t hear. They’ve got noses but can’t smell.
They’ve got hands but can’t feel. They’ve got feet but can’t walk. Not a sound comes from their throats.
The people who make them will end up like them, and so will everyone who trusts them.
Israel, put your trust in the LORD! He’s their help and their shield.
Family of Aaron, put your trust in the LORD! He’s their help and their shield.
You who fear the LORD, put your trust in him! He’s their help and their shield.
The LORD remembers us and will bless us. He’ll bless the family of Israel and the family of Aaron.
He’ll bless those who fear him, the small and the great alike.
May the LORD make you grow in number, you and your children.
May you be blessed by the LORD, the one who made heaven and earth.
The heavens belong to the LORD, but he gave the earth to human beings.
Dead people don’t praise the LORD, and neither does anyone who goes down into silence.
But we’ll bless the LORD from now on and forever. Praise the LORD!
